cards.example: 中国哲学有丰富的思想内容。
cards.exampleTranslation: Chinese philosophy has rich intellectual content.

cards.example: 古代的学校供贵族子弟学习。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ancient schools provided education for the children of nobles.

cards.example: 古代只有贵族子弟有机会接受教育。
cards.exampleTranslation: In ancient times, only the children of nobles had the opportunity to receive an education.

cards.example: 孔子认为学生不应该因为愚笨而放弃学习。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius believed students should not give up learning because they were slow-witted.

cards.back: to welcome; to be well received
cards.example: 孔子欢迎不同身份的人来学习。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius welcomed people of different social backgrounds to study.

cards.example: 苏格拉底是古希腊著名的哲学家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Socrates was a famous philosopher of ancient Greece.

cards.example: 释迦牟尼出生在古印度。
cards.exampleTranslation: Shakyamuni was born in ancient India.

cards.example: 我们应该真诚地对待别人。

cards.back: false friendship; hypocritical show of affection
cards.example: 真正的仁爱不是虚情假意。
cards.exampleTranslation: True benevolence is not a hypocritical show of affection.

cards.example: 我们可以从孔子的思想中学到一些道理。
cards.exampleTranslation: We can learn some principles from Confucius's thought.

cards.example: 仁爱包含对他人的真诚感情。
cards.exampleTranslation: Benevolence includes sincere feelings toward others.

cards.example: 古代哲学家思考人与整个宇宙的关系。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ancient philosophers considered the relationship between humanity and the entire universe.

cards.example: 他认为世间的一切都是相连的。
cards.exampleTranslation: He believed that everything in the world is interconnected.

cards.example: 我们应该尽心帮助有困难的人。
cards.exampleTranslation: We should do our utmost to help people in difficulty.

cards.example: 仁爱可以给别人带来幸福。
cards.exampleTranslation: Benevolence can bring happiness to others.

cards.example: 我们不应该把痛苦带给别人。
cards.exampleTranslation: We should not bring suffering to others.

cards.example: 即使遇到失败，也要继续努力。
cards.exampleTranslation: Even when we encounter failure, we should keep trying.

cards.example: 我们应该遵守社会规范。
